readback_body:
## Goal

Complete the **MCP-only no-op exporter optimization** in the existing MCP Documents feature (parent Requirement #3624). The baseline generator, official upstream spec verifier and public UI are already merged to `staging`. This follow-up is intentionally a separate Issue because its branch starts with an existing `pages-mcp` browser spec: the original parent Issue's `### New` E2E declaration is correct for baseline PR #3627 but is not correct for a subsequent PR.

## Scope

- A previously published MCP JSON must first pass the canonical existing source/digest validator.
- Always revalidate the official upstream **stable** MCP release, including its immutable version/tag/changelog hash.
- On a valid prior snapshot and unchanged upstream stable release, compare last published main commit to currently pinned main via the bounded GitHub compare API. If the comparison is complete (less than one 100-commit page and 300 file cap), ancestor/source-head verified, and there are no edits to MCP/Protocol crates, cargo/toolchain inputs or MCP projection owner scripts, reuse the exact prior MCP JSON and **do not invoke cargo**.
- Every code/schema/upstream change, truncated/failed/divergent comparison, missing or malformed prior source, or other uncertainty falls back to the canonical Rust Tool exporter and existing MCP semantic reconciler, never a false no-op.
- No GPT monitor, no new cron, no MCP runtime invocation, no change to trusted Pages publisher workflow, and no alteration of other Documents semantics.

## Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01: Deterministic source-aware no-op preserves the previous published MCP JSON bytes and source revision without invoking the Rust exporter on a verified unrelated main change.
- [x] SC-02: All meaningful source/Tool/protocol/lock/upstream changes, missing/forged/truncated comparisons and renamed MCP files cannot silently skip regeneration.
- [ ] SC-03: Existing `pages-mcp` browser regression and Pages unit/security tests pass on exact PR HEAD. First public HTTPS Pages projection remains a separate parent acceptance dependency after main release.

### SC scenario → proof mapping
SC-01 and SC-02: pure unit fixtures and CI Pages static boundary (SCN-01). SC-03: existing independently executed `pages-mcp` Chromium spec and exact CI run (SCN-02). Deployed source/HTTPS readback remains owned by parent #3624.

## Acceptance Plan
```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-03:
    when: pr
    method: agent
```

## Acceptance Report

| SC-01 | Pass | run 43714384066; ref fcfc0999c19df8b57c1847e8c26db8641c02de50; source agent-qwen; file: pages/scripts/mcp-export-gate.mjs:23-49 implements canReusePublishedMcp() with prior source SHA validation (line 34), bounded GitHub comparison, and consistency checks; file: pages/scripts/mcp-reconcile.mjs:40-58 preserves exact previous bytes when semantic digest unchanged; test: pages/tests/mcp-export-gate.test.mjs:27-31 verifies unrelated bounded changes skip exporter and preserve prior source SHA; test: pages/tests/mcp-reconcile.test.mjs:16-26 verifies identical repeated builds preserve exact source revision; summary: Deterministic source-aware no-op validates prior source SHA against comparison base_commit, bounded GitHub API, and preserves previous MCP JSON bytes when source unchanged |
| SC-02 | Pass | run 43714384066; ref fcfc0999c19df8b57c1847e8c26db8641c02de50; source agent-qwen; file: pages/scripts/mcp-export-gate.mjs:15-22 affectsMcpSource() checks MCP/protocol crates, Cargo, toolchain, projection scripts; file: pages/scripts/mcp-export-gate.mjs:23-49 rejects no-op on invalid previous, changed upstream, missing/truncated comparison, inconsistent commit counts, renamed MCP files; test: pages/tests/mcp-export-gate.test.mjs:32-49 tests all Tool/protocol/dependency/lock changes force reexport including renamed files; test: pages/tests/mcp-export-gate.test.mjs:50-69 tests invalid comparisons: base_commit SHA mismatch (line 60), inconsistent ahead_by vs total_commits (lines 62-64), truncated/unverifiable comparisons; summary: All meaningful source changes, missing/forged/truncated comparisons and renamed MCP files cannot silently skip regeneration via comprehensive validation and negative test fixtures |
| SC-03 | Pending | run 43714384066; ref fcfc0999c19df8b57c1847e8c26db8641c02de50; source agent-qwen; file: e2e/tests/browser/pages-mcp.spec.ts exists with 2 test cases for MCP Documents browser regression; file: pages/tests/mcp-export-gate.test.mjs, mcp-reconcile.test.mjs, mcp-semantic.test.mjs, mcp-upstream.test.mjs provide unit test coverage; workflow: .github/workflows/ci-pages.yml:26-87 configured to run Pages unit/security tests and browser smoke at exact PR HEAD; other: ci_evidence is null - no authenticated CI run results provided to verify tests passed at exact PR HEAD fcfc0999c; summary: Test infrastructure exists and code appears correct, but absence of CI evidence prevents verification that tests actually passed at exact PR HEAD |

- none: `pages-mcp` was created by parent PR #3627, not by this follow-up

- pages-mcp

## Knowledge Impact
- Decision: Read
- Related knowledge: parent MCP Documents #3624 and `pages/AGENTS.md`
- Reason: no new schema/API, only safe source-bound build optimization
- Owner and timing: Pages generator owner before merge
- Evidence: code, negative fixtures and exact-HEAD CI

## Prototype
- Decision: None; no UI changes

## Product alignment
Preserves minimal, verifiable source-backed AI capability docs without unnecessary Rust compilation or an independent monitoring service.

**Status:** Approved follow-up implementation slice of #3624. Release/public Pages acceptance remains pending.
